profile.name: Telnet 连接接口
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于通过 Telnet 协议连接远程主机。在实验系统中可用于建立会话、发送文本命令、读取返回数据、处理 Telnet 选项协商，以及进行交互式远程控制。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component for connecting to remote hosts over the Telnet protocol. In laboratory systems, it can be used to open sessions, send text commands, read returned data, handle Telnet option negotiation, and support interactive remote control.
